name: It's Raining Monkeys
author: Addicting Games
description: Get ready for a wild adventure in It's Raining Monkeys! Step into a whimsical world where you wield an umbrella to bounce mischievous monkeys around and tackle mind-bending puzzles. With each clever move, you'll navigate through playful challenges, using your umbrella to swing and bounce your way to success. Can you outsmart the mischievous monkeys and conquer the puzzle-filled skies? Embrace the chaos, master the art of monkey manipulation, and let the rain of fun begin!
